description: Quote the exact Gold price to rig and animate one of the user's 3D models with Tripo Animate (the rig is included): 1 to 5 moves, one named clip each in one file. Price by the number of moves: 1 move 50 Gold, 2 moves 65, 3 moves 75, 4 moves 90, 5 moves 105. Returns gold_cost and quote_token without starting a job or charging Gold. After the user approves, call chargen_edit_3d_animate with the same inputs and quote_token.

bone_names.description: Bone naming standard, for the engine the model goes to (default tripo).

file_format.description: File type of the result (default glb). Tripo can return FBX even when glb is asked for.

in_place.description: Keep the model in place instead of moving forward (default false).

model_id.description: A 3D model from the user's own gallery: an image_id from chargen_search_gallery with media_type model_3d, or a finished 3D job's image_id.

moves.description: 1 to 5 moves, one clip each (default walk). Each move adds to the price.

rig_type.description: Body type of the skeleton (default auto).

name: chargen_quote_3d_animate
title: Quote 3D animation
